answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds are instantiated as a graduated terrace of staking collateral to prohibit Sybil proliferation. Through subgame-perfect slashing matrices, we enforce a ferrous security threshold that penalizes any attempt at network expansion via a spreading vine of fraudulent nodes.
